issue: Incident AI analysis rejects systemId:null when the incident has no selected system
environment: fresh isolated recording profile; installed v1.1.0
uiError: Invalid input: expected string, received null
source: IncidentsManagement.analyze forwards system_id; ai:triageIncident schema uses string.optional()
filmingWorkaround: Use a synthetic incident with an explicitly selected synthetic system
severityForPresentation: Known edge case, disclosed in limitations/Q&A/runbook. Does not demonstrate general support for unassigned-system AI inputs.
